structured_output.what_is_happening: A 14-minute-old Meteora (non-pump.fun) pool for "Memetically-Engineered product" (m/ep) is getting heavy volume: $637k in the first hour against a ~$24-32k market cap, with price up 131-229%. It is one of at least 10 same-name copies launched within about an hour. The creator wallet holds 49.67% of supply, the LP is 100% unlocked and not burned, and GMGN flags 92 bundler wallets. The only social link is a tweet from CookedSupermann, an X account that posts about memes going viral in order to launch coins on them.

narrative.description: A self-referential 'memetic engineering' meme coin name, probably sparked by a tweet (CookedSupermann status 2103771937893965880) that I could not read. The name plays on the idea of memetic engineering. I found no real-world event behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet from a meme-coin narrative account set off a scramble of copycat deploys. Web search shows a pump.fun version at about $78k with +1652%, which is probably the one people actually mean. I found no organic spread beyond that.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is a Meteora pool created later (10:20Z) than the pump.fun versions. It is not a pump address, the creator kept half the supply, and it has no profile or links apart from the tweet link on GeckoTerminal.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens. 6mEf...pump (created earliest among the active ones, $347k volume in 1h, $47k mcap) and 9Bro... ($333k volume in 1h) are live competitors. Web search shows a pump.fun m/ep at $78k.

authenticity.evidence: 92 bundler wallets, and the top bundler trader share is 47.6%. The creator holds 49.67% of supply in its own wallet. 1,736 unique buyers but only 99 unique sellers, which fits a pattern of bot or bundle buys. It is a clone deploy with unlocked LP.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count is large, so some real retail may be getting pulled in by the search for the viral ticker.

structural_risks: The creator holds 49.67% of supply against ~$36k of liquidity. A dump would crush the price.
LP is 100% unlocked (lp_burn_ratio 0), so the deployer can remove liquidity at any time.
Ticker clone that is not the canonical token; it is competing with several other copies

structured_output.counterargument: Momentum is extreme: +65% in 5 minutes, 486 unique buyers in 5 minutes, and a price near its all-time high. If this pool becomes the most liquid m/ep, a quick 2x from a $32k market cap is mechanically easy before the creator exits.
unknowns: What the CookedSupermann tweet says, and whether it endorses this contract
Which contract the community treats as the canonical one
The creator's intentions for the 49.67% it holds

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. Searching the contract address found nothing. The name search surfaced only a pump.fun listing for another m/ep. The CookedSupermann search found the account but not the m/ep tweet.

structured_output.thesis: A copycat Meteora clone of a ticker that is spreading fast, where the creator kept half the supply, the LP is unlocked and 92 bundlers are present. It is most likely a quick extraction. Momentum is real but short-lived, and rug risk dominates.
